rows.title: C, versioned interface
rows.requirement: The native interface SHALL identify the exact ZKIR instruction semantics, compiler/lowerer, proof format, transcript, circuit/VK, SRS provenance, accumulator/decider format and ledger verifier versions required by an artifact. Unsupported combinations SHALL fail closed before financial acceptance.
rows.acceptance: Compatible tuple proves/verifies; change one version, transcript or serialization identifier and obtain explicit rejection. Retained artifacts verify in an independently installed compatible verifier.
rows.presentSupport: Separate local pins and the historical contract/inner transcript mismatch are known; a comprehensive compatible release tuple is unknown.
rows.milestone: Pin and validate compatible tuple, including node proof-verification configuration; U0/U1

rows.title: C, general program relations
rows.requirement: The interface SHALL support recursively composing proofs of developer-defined bounded relations expressible in the supported ZKIR profile, including both same-relation steps and explicitly compatible different-relation steps, without a maintainer program allowlist.
rows.acceptance: Independently author a new two-asset relation outside loan/swap fixtures; prove two steps. Compose compatible heterogeneous steps; reject a wrong relation with otherwise valid proof bytes.
rows.presentSupport: MPS-0014 proposes same/cross-circuit composition. General Moriarty native capability is unestablished.
rows.owner: Native recursive proof API, constraint implementation and ledger final verifier
rows.milestone: Express legitimate compatible financial relations, full parents and duties; U4

rows.title: C, complete statement binding
rows.requirement: Recursive verification SHALL bind canonical public inputs or binding commitments for program/semantics, property, signed intent, domain, predecessors, observations, complete effects, residual duties and resource limits; the application circuit SHALL enforce equality within the same canonical representation and pinned correspondence/refinement links where source, Core, ZKIR and ledger representations differ. Distinct representation hashes are expected; their authorized linkage is enforced.
rows.acceptance: Mutate each component individually while retaining other valid objects: every unauthorized mismatch of identity or its correspondence linkage rejects; mere inequality of different representation hashes is not a failure. Authorized witness variation and alternative permitted routes remain valid.
rows.presentSupport: Ordinary proof input machinery exists, but this complete Moriarty statement and correspondence are open.
rows.owner: ZKIR semantics/constraints, compiler and ledger context binding
rows.milestone: Prove source/intent/effect correspondence and mandatory-predicate enforcement; U1/U2/U4

rows.title: C, genesis and well-foundedness
rows.requirement: A recursive compliance relation SHALL distinguish legitimate base cases from recursive cases and enforce well-founded descent or an equivalent sound induction structure; genesis funding, authority and initialization SHALL be authenticated.
rows.acceptance: Valid funded base and descendants verify; fabricated funded/approved genesis, recursive proof relabeled base, cycle and rank-wraparound reject. Require a soundness argument, not only finite tests.
rows.presentSupport: An IVC example exists; application genesis and general sequence/DAG theorem are unestablished. A rank counter is one choice, not mandated syntax.
rows.owner: Native recursion soundness plus application base/preservation relation
rows.milestone: Authenticate funded genesis and well-founded financial history; U4

rows.title: C, verifier identity
rows.requirement: Every verified predecessor SHALL use a VK/relation identity authorized by the bound program policy, including any accumulator state and decider identity; a prover SHALL NOT select a weaker relation by substituting a key.
rows.acceptance: Proof of a trivial true circuit, wrong VK, wrong decider, stale compatible-looking module or substituted IVC state identity rejects. Explicitly authorized compatible module succeeds.
rows.presentSupport: Historical PR738 described pinned inner-key hashes and a Collapsed-state hazard; current fix/deployment status unknown. Fixed keys and policy-checked dynamic keys are alternative realizations.
rows.owner: Native recursive proof API, constraint implementation and ledger final verifier
rows.milestone: Express legitimate compatible financial relations, full parents and duties; U4

rows.title: C, adversarial-witness soundness
rows.requirement: For the supported profile, satisfaction of target constraints SHALL imply a valid semantic realization for every accepted witness, including type/range, Boolean, inactive-branch, encoding and output-shape premises. Honest-witness preprocessing SHALL NOT be the sole enforcement of such premises.
rows.acceptance: Prove the implication; challenge non-Boolean selectors/assertions, out-of-width comparisons, noncanonical encodings, unconstrained outputs and altered inactive-branch values where semantically material. Valid boundary values must remain accepted.
rows.presentSupport: Explicit preconditions and constraint operations are visible locally. PR17's WShape premise remains conditional evidence, not blanket target soundness.
rows.owner: ZKIR semantics/constraints, compiler and ledger context binding
rows.milestone: Prove source/intent/effect correspondence and mandatory-predicate enforcement; U1/U2/U4

rows.title: C, mandatory verification/control
rows.requirement: The application relation SHALL ensure every mandatory predecessor and intention predicate constrains acceptance, including verification guards and all supported branches. An inactive verifier SHALL NOT satisfy an obligation for an active predecessor.
rows.acceptance: Set verification guard to zero, discard a computed false result, omit one required parent, or route through a failure branch that bypasses mandatory checks: reject. A deliberately optional inactive parent follows its specified semantics.
rows.presentSupport: Historical PR738 allowed guard-based disabling. Safe application dominance and actual current lowering remain unestablished. This does not prohibit useful optional guards.
rows.owner: ZKIR semantics/constraints, compiler and ledger context binding
rows.milestone: Prove source/intent/effect correspondence and mandatory-predicate enforcement; U1/U2/U4

rows.title: C, complete deferred verification
rows.requirement: Before financial acceptance, the native verifier/ledger SHALL discharge every deferred cryptographic obligation necessary for the recursive statement, including all accumulators and final pairing/decider checks, binding them to the outer statement. No API SHALL report final validity after only the outer proof check when obligations remain.
rows.acceptance: Use a well-formed but invalid inner proof and a valid proof for the wrong instance that still permit outer proof construction; final verification rejects both. Dropped/substituted accumulators, semantic mismatches caused by reordering, and bypass paths reject; sound order-insensitive batching remains permitted.
rows.presentSupport: Frozen September 11 evidence reports the accumulator pairing caught such cases in a PR test. Production/native general integration unknown. Separate or safely batched checks are both acceptable.
rows.owner: Native recursive proof API, constraint implementation and ledger final verifier
rows.milestone: Express legitimate compatible financial relations, full parents and duties; U4

rows.title: C, bounded multi-parent joins
rows.requirement: The interface SHALL support a declared bounded number of predecessor proofs, at least two for MC06, and the application join relation SHALL enforce predecessor compatibility, resource partition/recombination, complete duties and aggregate budgets without double-counting common ancestry. The per-stage fan-in bound does not impose a single fixed global DAG depth; growing finite well-founded histories preserve declared episode/lifetime budgets through authorized continuation.
rows.acceptance: Split, advance two branches and join; reject duplicated spendable parent, missing branch duty, incompatible intent/domain, and cumulative-budget duplication. Harmless shared ancestry is accepted when correctly accounted.
rows.presentSupport: General bounded joins and their full financial relation are open. Repeated verification instructions or a dedicated join primitive are alternative implementations.
rows.owner: Native recursive proof API, constraint implementation and ledger final verifier
rows.milestone: Express legitimate compatible financial relations, full parents and duties; U4

rows.title: C, state and ledger consumption
rows.requirement: Native acceptance SHALL bind proved predecessor/resource identities to authenticated current ledger state and enforce the declared unique-consumption/nonce rules; imported certificates SHALL carry an authenticated anchor and cannot manufacture currentness.
rows.acceptance: Race two valid successors of one spendable state; at most one consumes it. Reject stale head, absent-head creation without authenticated absence, replay across domains and unrecognized anchor.
rows.presentSupport: Historical ledger read validation is relevant evidence; the complete recursion/consumption integration is unestablished. Proof validity alone cannot provide this property.
rows.owner: Ledger current-state/consumption interfaces plus application contracts
rows.milestone: Head/absence checks and unique single-lineage consumption at U2; completeness/concurrency/composition extensions at U3/U4

rows.title: C, compiler/effect correspondence
rows.requirement: The compiler and accepted native statement SHALL preserve source stage results, rejection, exact arithmetic, effects and residual state, including guaranteed/fallible phase layout and every permitted retained-fee outcome.
rows.acceptance: Two-phase case with failed fallible business action: recorded guaranteed effects/fees match signed policy, nonce and duties. Unauthorized fee, missing liability or invented rollback rejects. Prove arbitrary-accepted-witness correspondence for the supported slice.
rows.presentSupport: Source/5 and restricted Compact paths exist separately; full source/native/ledger relation is open. New ZKIR opcodes are not intrinsically required if existing constraints suffice.
rows.owner: ZKIR semantics/constraints, compiler and ledger context binding
rows.milestone: Prove source/intent/effect correspondence and mandatory-predicate enforcement; U1/U2/U4

rows.title: C, public boundedness
rows.requirement: Each admitted artifact SHALL have checked bounds for its stage computation, predecessor arity, public inputs, proof parsing, accumulators, memory-relevant structures and late-bound components under a pinned resource model. Exhaustion SHALL yield explicit rejection or a specified outcome without weakening mandatory verification.
rows.acceptance: Test each bound at maximum and one over; malicious lengths, excessive parents, huge proof encodings and budget-counter overflow reject predictably. Establish bound soundness independently of elapsed benchmark time.
rows.presentSupport: Explicit bounded IR/source components exist; complete recursive-stage accounting remains unknown. Stage termination is not lifecycle liveness.
rows.owner: ZKIR, prover/verifier resource interfaces and ledger costing
rows.milestone: Bind per-stage/cumulative work and reserves; U1/U3/U4

rows.title: C/P, honest cost and feasibility reporting
rows.requirement: Tooling SHALL report circuit rows/degree, proof/VK/PK and accumulator sizes, prover/verifier time and peak memory for the complete supported path; ledger costing SHALL account for deferred verification work. Performance objectives SHALL be stated separately and SHALL NOT permit skipped correctness checks.
rows.acceptance: Publish measurements across step depth, parent arity and heterogeneous relations with all final checks enabled, named hardware and versions; stress maximum supported shape and verify charged work coverage.
rows.presentSupport: Historical measurements are useful machine-specific baselines. Future budgets/latency targets are not yet negotiated; no numeric target is asserted here.
rows.owner: ZKIR, prover/verifier resource interfaces and ledger costing
rows.milestone: Bind per-stage/cumulative work and reserves; U1/U3/U4

rows.title: C, private continuation interface
rows.requirement: The recursive interface SHALL permit statements over binding private-state commitments with proved consistency, and tooling SHALL identify precisely which witness/proof/key artifacts a separately controlled successor needs. Claimed privacy SHALL name observers and leakage; proof reuse SHALL NOT be advertised as delivery of hidden state.
rows.acceptance: Separate Alice/Bob environments perform supported continuation and split/join without unauthorized secret access; missing witness data surfaces as unavailable, not a fabricated proof. Prove/assess declared confidentiality separately.
rows.presentSupport: Native ZK is a foundation, not a private handoff theorem. MC06's separate-party witness and privacy obligations remain open. MPC is one possible provider with explicit assumptions, not a mandatory backend replacement.
rows.owner: Native private-input interface and proving tools; kernel where joint proving is selected
rows.milestone: Privacy policy, witness transfer and availability, separate-party tests without the federated kernel at U4; optional kernel-assisted profile under UNI-011 at U5

rows.title: C, semantic migration
rows.requirement: A change to program, relation, VK, verifier or continuation schema SHALL preserve authenticated state, consumed resources, duties, recovery and disclosure constraints under the signed migration policy, or require applicable amendment authority.
rows.acceptance: Interface-compatible but semantically weaker upgrade rejects; authorized migration preserves consumed identities, outstanding debt and cumulative fees. Prior authorization cannot replay on a fresh domain accidentally.
rows.presentSupport: Historical mutable deployment keys motivate this requirement. Full policy-preserving recursive migration is unknown. Immutable deployments are a valid initial implementation.
rows.owner: Ledger key/state evolution interfaces plus application policy

rows.title: C, independent reproducibility and assurance
rows.requirement: Native APIs SHALL distinguish compiled, synthesized, proved, outer-verified, fully verified and ledger-finalized evidence and expose retained proof/statement artifacts for independent final verification with pinned dependencies.
rows.acceptance: Independent verifier accepts retained valid two-step MC03 proof and MC06 split/join proof without original prover service; tampered statement/proof/key rejects. A simulation, mock proof or outer-only success never receives final-valid status.
rows.presentSupport: Scoped proving examples and financial receipts exist; this end-to-end public developer evidence remains open.
rows.owner: Native library/tooling and actual ledger configuration
rows.milestone: Independent retained proof and effect verification; U4/U7

rows.title: Transcript and challenge specification
rows.requirement: The qualified backend SHALL specify canonical transcript absorption order, domain tags, encodings, cross-field/limb conversion where non-native arithmetic is used, and challenge derivation, including verifier identity and recursive messages; circuit and native verifiers SHALL implement that same contract.
rows.acceptance: Compatible vectors agree; changed index digest, omitted challenge commitment, ambiguous encoding, invalid limbs and semantically changed parent ordering reject.

rows.title: Deferred obligations, base cases and active masks
rows.requirement: The interface SHALL identify each deferred obligation, authenticated inputs, producer, consumer and connecting invariant; final acceptance SHALL discharge every active obligation. Branch choice, predecessor cardinality, padding and base-case masks SHALL be constrained by the authorized relation.
rows.acceptance: Valid base and two-parent continuation pass. Changed deferred scalar/sponge, disabled required finalizer, empty required batch, recursive case relabeled base and dummy promoted to parent reject.

rows.title: Heterogeneous compatibility and key authorization
rows.requirement: Each side-loaded relation SHALL bind statement schema, field order/encoding, child recursive shape, supported features, backend-specific proof-shape parameters (domain size and, where applicable, chunking or opening arity), key and parameter identity. Key data-to-identity integrity and identity-to-owner/program authorization SHALL both hold.
rows.acceptance: Compatible authorized heterogeneous relations pass; same-shaped trivial relation, misleading key hash, unauthorized key-root update, incompatible feature/field count and oversized domain reject. Distinguish child shape, direct fan-in and total ancestry.

rows.title: Verified values and auxiliary output
rows.requirement: Tooling SHALL distinguish parsed proof data, cryptographically verified statements, witness-only or auxiliary values, predicted effects and authenticated actual effects. Every mandatory effect/history dependency SHALL be constrained and verified; current-state settlement SHALL include authoritative preconditions.
rows.acceptance: Invalid predecessor with consistent public fields, omitted verify call, altered auxiliary fee/recipient and valid stale-state proof cannot authorize effects. A verified permitted successor bound to current state passes.

rows.title: Production proof-mode separation
rows.requirement: Evidence collection and deployed acceptance SHALL assert real proving and complete verification configuration; simulation, dummy proofs, disabled-proof mode and empty test keys SHALL be visibly distinct and SHALL NOT qualify production acceptance.
rows.acceptance: A local test-mode success with dummy proof fails an independent real verifier; mode toggles and mock ledger paths cannot yield a final-valid evidence record.

rows.title: Parameter and cache provenance
rows.requirement: Cache and parameter artifacts SHALL bind content digests, semantic/build tuple, purpose and expected identity. Batch parameters SHALL have a common authenticated identity or a proved compatibility relation; equal dimensions alone SHALL NOT establish compatibility.
rows.acceptance: Cold/warm builds preserve qualified semantics; stale/corrupt/relabeled cache entries reject or safely rebuild. Equal-length incompatible parameters reject or use an explicitly sound separate verification path.

rows.title: Batching and join soundness
rows.requirement: Batching SHALL specify coefficient/challenge generation, full-batch binding, randomness assumptions, required cardinality and composed soundness error. Any bounded-fan-in tree decomposition SHALL preserve authorized parent coverage, duties and budgets.
rows.acceptance: A batch with one invalid member fails under its stated security guarantee; empty required batches, omitted member and adversarial cancellation/coefficient attempts fail. Binary-tree and permitted direct joins preserve the same financial relation; harmless shared ancestry is not duplicated spending.

rows.title: Specification and component assurance coverage
rows.requirement: The qualification dossier SHALL trace mathematical statement, specification, compiler constraint and final verifier code for every used feature, and record exact audit/theorem scope and gaps for dependencies, custom gates, lookups, bindings and recursion.
rows.acceptance: A historical recursion-layer audit cannot qualify an unaudited gate or changed tuple. A complete supported-feature matrix names evidence or an open obligation for every component; documentation/code disagreement remains unresolved until reconciled.
